title: Open Hand of God
story:
A poor traveler once walked through a dry and empty land.

He had very little food left.

His strength was fading.

He worried about how he would survive.

After a long journey, he reached a small village.

An old man there invited him to rest.

He brought food and water and placed it before him.

The traveler asked,

“Why are you helping me so freely?”

The old man replied,

“Because everything I have was also given to me.”

In life, we often fear lack.

We worry about tomorrow.

We feel unsure about provision.

But God’s hand is always open.

He provides for every living thing.

Nothing is outside His care.

And His goodness never runs out.
life_lesson: God’s open hand provides for all your needs.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for Your generous provision.

Thank You for sustaining my life every day.

Help me to trust You and not fear lack.

Teach me to rest in Your goodness.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Are you worried about your future provision?

How does God’s open hand bring you peace?

What can you trust Him with today?
verse:
You open Your hand
and satisfy the desires of every living thing.
